seller_or_subject: Trustpilot seller reports all completed orders auto-cancelled post-delivery
what: Seller reports that Etsy automatically cancelled all completed, shipped, and delivered orders due to a supposed identity verification issue, resulting in customers keeping items and receiving refunds while the seller never received payouts.
verbatim_snippet: "My orders were completed, shipped, and customers received their items and even left positive reviews. However, Etsy automatically cancelled all orders due to a supposed identity verification issue, even though I submitted my ID multiple times. Customers kept the items AND received refunds, while I never received my sales payout."
notes: Trustpilot review found via Google search snippet (etsy.de Trustpilot page). Exact review date not confirmed. Identity verification issue. Financial loss from auto-cancelled orders where goods were already delivered. Degraded to Part 4 due to imprecise date.
